title: Simulation and Analysis of Event History Data
text: example simulating data using simEventData.simEventData function general event history simulations. function quite flexible, therefore take many arguments. can read different arguments help page number simulated events corresponds length vectors , , number columns . , create 9x5 beta matrix 5 event processes 4 baseline covariates: can add baseline covariates supplying generator functions: Define function specify risk windows recurrent events: Optionally one can define function specify risk windows function covariates: Simulate data 5000 individuals: Preview simulated data:
code: ?simEventData set.seed(736) beta <- matrix(rnorm(9*5), ncol = 5, nrow = 9) func1 <- function(N) rbinom(N, 1, 0.2) func2 <- function(N) rnorm(N) add_cov <- list("Z1" = func1, "Z2" = func2) # at risk function at_risk <- function(events) {   return(c(     1,1,                         # Always at risk for event 0 and 1     as.numeric(events[3] < 2),   # Event 2 can occur twice     as.numeric(events[4] < 1),   # Event 3 can occur once     as.numeric(events[5] < 2)))  # Event 4 can occur twice } # at risk function at_risk_cov <- function(covariates) {   return(c(     1,1,                               # The covariates do not change the risk of event 0 and 1     as.numeric(covariates[1] < 0.5),   # Only at risk of event 2 if L0 < 0.5     as.numeric(covariates[2] == 1),    # Only at risk of event 3 if A0 = 1     1))                                # The covariates do not change the risk of event 4 } set.seed(973) data <- simEventData(N = 5000, beta = beta, add_cov = add_cov, at_risk = at_risk,                      at_risk_cov = at_risk_cov) head(data) #> Key: <ID> #>       ID      Time Delta        L0    A0    Z1         Z2    N0    N1    N2 #>    <int>     <num> <int>     <num> <num> <num>      <num> <num> <num> <num> #> 1:     1 0.5067418     4 0.0482511     1     0  0.9036369     0     0     0 #> 2:     1 0.7741479     0 0.0482511     1     0  0.9036369     1     0     0 #> 3:     2 0.7952969     1 0.2186699     0     0  1.0631460     0     1     0 #> 4:     3 4.3490086     1 0.5021846     0     0 -0.2266280     0     1     0 #> 5:     4 0.1689083     0 0.4053148     1     0  1.2534397     1     0     0 #> 6:     5 1.5183445     3 0.3986500     1     0 -0.9204445     0     0     0 #>       N3    N4 #>    <num> <num> #> 1:     0     1 #> 2:     0     1 #> 3:     0     0 #> 4:     0     0 #> 5:     0     0 #> 6:     1     0
